subject: Error  Unknown directive "auth_passwd_file" while starting shiny-server

messages.author: ccb466922a59fe63
messages.subject: Error  Unknown directive "auth_passwd_file" while starting shiny-server
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to  start the shiny server using the command " sudo start shiny-server" ... My server was running properly for too many days. I just modified the file to change the port from 3838 to 443 and then again reverted the change. It is giving me a strange error.

Error Loading Config: Unknown directive "auth_passwd_file"  (/etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf:6:1)

Please help me with the error.

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: Error  Unknown directive "auth_passwd_file" while starting shiny-server
parts:
Is it possible that you installed the open source shiny server over a shiny server pro trial?  
If so, you need to change your shiny-server.conf file to strip out any shiny server pro related settings.

-Tareef
